etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English heightenen, hyghtenen, equivalent to height +‎ -en (verbal suffix).

definitions.definition: To make high; to raise higher; to elevate.

quote.citation: 2021 June 2, “Network News: Cambrian Line bridge is raised”, in RAIL, number 932, page 23:
quote.text: Black Bridge, near Machynlleth, is being heightened by one metre in a £3.6 million project to reduce delays caused by flooding.

definitions.definition: To advance, increase, augment, make larger, more intense, stronger etc.

quote.citation: 2006 December 6, Ashley Seager, “Employment rise gives chancellor a boost”, in The Guardian‎[1]:
quote.text: If Mr Brown chooses, he could raise his estimate of the economy's "trend" rate of growth in the coming years and so heighten his hopes of tax revenues.
